capabilities.description: Clubs can book the whole rink or half of it at a club hourly rate. Each month they are invoiced for the hours they booked.
capabilities.name: Club rink booking and monthly invoicing

capabilities.description: Managers schedule public skating sessions. Each session's capacity is reduced when clubs hold half the rink or all of it. The public can list sessions, and managers get weekly reports.
capabilities.name: Skating session scheduling and capacity planning

capabilities.description: Ice temperature readings are recorded. After 10 minutes of warm ice, the next session is put on hold and skaters are notified. A held session is then either cancelled with refunds or released for sale again.
capabilities.name: Ice condition monitoring and session hold handling

capabilities.description: Skaters buy priced tickets that reserve places. Results from the payment provider settle the bookings, and unpaid bookings are released after 15 minutes.
capabilities.name: Ticket sales and payment settlement

capabilities.description: Members are registered and get an allowance of free entries.
capabilities.name: Membership with free-entry allowance

capabilities.description: The rink tracks its stock of hire skates and how many are available against pending and paid bookings.
capabilities.name: Skate hire

capabilities.description: When a business rule is broken, the failure is reported as a distinct domain error with an explanatory message.
capabilities.name: Business rule enforcement
